newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Kabila unlikely to visit Kisangani Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Kabila unlikely to visit Kisangani Sunday.

text.p: Zaire rebel leader Laurent Kabila is unlikely to travel to the newly captured city of Kisangani as scheduled on Sunday due to landmines at the airport, an aide and a rebel security official said.
"The airport was heavily mined and we should be sure that security is absolute before anybody at all goes there," a rebel security official said.
Rebel troops occupied Kisangani on Saturday, the army's base in eastern Zaire.

The Tutsi-led rebels have seized control of about one-fifth of the vast country at the heart of Africa since the start of their campaign to topple President Mobutu Sese Seko five months ago. They now say they will target Zaire's second city Lubumbashi.
Kabila earlier said he would fly to Kisangani, the site of the biggest rebel victory so far.
"Perhaps he has put off the visit," information chief Raphael Ghenda told reporters in Goma, Kabila's headquarters.
